item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a bedtime set for late evening, with a relaxation practice before it. That's a good structure. Sleep gets protected by what happens in the hour before it, not by good intentions at midnight. Dim the lights, put screens away, and let your body get the signal that the day is done. Tonight, start your wind-down when the reminder goes off, and don't negotiate with it.
